mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 AM, the temperature is 60 degrees with clear skies around Verona City Hall and a full moon shining, though the air quality index is at a moderate 55.
The city is hosting an I Voted sticker contest for students in grades K through 12. Voting is open now through midnight on August 7 for the designs that will be featured in the November election.

Today, you can check out the Downtown Farmer's Market, yoga at Insight Wellness, or trivia at The Bogey Factory. Tomorrow, look forward to Concerts in the Park at Century School Park and trivia at Hop Haus.
In a notable incident this past Saturday, a 55-year-old woman was arrested for O W I after she was pulled over for driving 97 miles per hour on the highway.
Today, you can enjoy the delicious Caramel Peanut Buttercup. The restaurant is currently closed but will open its doors at 10 AM for all your custard cravings.
